simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עָנָף (H6057) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 7 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: עָנָף (ʻânâph) means a twig (as covering the limbs) First listed occurrence: Ezek 17 8.

definitions.full: H6057. anaph עָנָף noun [masculine] branch(es), bough(s) ; — usually singular collective, absolute ׳ע branches of vine Ezek 17:8 , plural only suffix עֲנָפֶיהָ Psa 80:11 (both in figure); boughs of tree, construct עֲנַף Lev 23:40 , suffix (as if from ֗֗֗ עֶנֶף Kö ii. 1, 74 ) עַנְמְּכֶם Ezek 36:8 ; singular absolute (in figurative) Malachi 3:19, of cedar 17:23 ; 31:3 .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to cover ;
